# reselling_load_balancer_plans (Data Source)

Active load balancer plans with your monthly price.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "reselling_load_balancer_plans" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only plans whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `plans` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))

<a id="nestedatt--plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans`

Read-Only:

- `cores` (Number)
- `disk_gb` (Number)
- `display_name` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `memory_mb` (Number)
- `monthly_price` (Number) Your monthly price in EUR.
- `name` (String)
